**Job Description

**_Are you a recent graduate or in the early stages of your career, and would you like to turn data into useful knowledge? And would you like to work directly with clients while keeping up to date with new technologies within data engineering? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools.

_

• Contract: Full-time

• Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

**Work Assignments

**This is a hands-on coding role focused on turning complex data challenges into production-ready solutions while talking with our clients to ensure we deliver according to their needs.

Specifically, you will:

• Build robust data pipelines and models that streamline the ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data.

• Implement and develop modern data platforms through DevOps & CI/CD practices.

• Collaborate with our clients’ engineers, analysts, & business users to solve business issues and ensure lasting value.

You will be guided by and learn from our many senior data engineers.

**About You

**Ideally, you have:

• Either recently completed (or soon to complete) a Master’s degree in a relevant field or worked as a Data Engineer but still in the start of your career.

• Proficiency in either Python, PySpark, SQL, or APIs.

• It’s a plus if you have experience with Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, or AI technologies, but if you don’t have it, no worries - we will teach you!

• An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

• Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

• A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still highly encourage you to apply.

**Why Devoteam Data Driven?

**You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with great colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

• Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our core technologies. We are sure you’ll thrive by being inspired and inspiring others across our global network of data experts.

• Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited self-paid time off when you want it.

• Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year with all sorts of fun activities outside of work. We have committees that plan sports, cultural and party events which you are more than welcome to participate in.

**Our Impact

**Below are a few examples of our recent work:

• Migrated Novo’s global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using DBT, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

• Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

• Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service landscape to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

**Application Process

**Apply by uploading your CV and grades **no later than November 23rd.

**We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

**About Devoteam

**Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

jobs.occupation: Oliver Wyman – Senior Consultant- (m/f/d) – Stockholm or Copenhagen
jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**What You Will Do

**As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

**You will:

**

• Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.

• Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.

• Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.

• Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.

• Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

**Why join us?

****You can be your best here

**At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact

**

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader

**

• Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.

• Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.

• Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

**Learn and grow without limits

**

• Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.

• Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.

• Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

**

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

**Experience Rewards That Work For You

**

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

**Who can apply?

**We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

**Required Qualifications

**

• 3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

• Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.

• Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.

• Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.

• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

• Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.

• Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language

• Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

**Nice to have

**

• Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.

• CFA or equivalent professional certification.

• MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

**What we're looking for?

**Successful candidates demonstrate:

• Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.

• Strong ownership and accountability.

• Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.

• Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

**How to apply?

**Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

**What to expect during the interviews process?

**At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business..

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Join Red Hat Consulting and lead the on-site delivery and implementation of cutting-edge technologies that empower customers with freedom, flexibility, choice, and performance. As a Senior Cloud Consultant, you will work closely with our customers to understand their infrastructure and business needs, delivering tailored recommendations and technical solutions. You'll leverage your deep expertise in cloud technologies in a dynamic, fast-paced environment to drive adoption of Red Hat’s open source solutions.

**What You Will Do

**

• Act as a subject matter expert on-site, addressing customers’ technical, developmental, and strategic IT requirements

• Lead efforts in problem identification, system architecture design, software specification, testing, and deployment

• Recommend and implement open source solutions to solve complex business challenges

• Continuously learn and apply new technologies to meet evolving customer needs

• Effectively respond to incidents, escalations, and critical issues

• Provide clear, actionable recommendations aligned with Red Hat's technologies

**What You Will Bring

**

• Proven experience in Linux system administration and performance tuning

• Hands-on experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, or similar container platforms

• Strong background in enterprise cloud implementations and business impact assessments

• Experience with virtualization technologies in large-scale enterprise environments

• Familiarity with cloud management tools and platforms

• Proficient in automation technologies such as Red Hat Ansible, Chef, or Puppet

• Strong communication skills to convey value, progress, and project metrics to stakeholders

• Excellent problem-solving, project management, and planning abilities

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Swedish or Danish

• Willingness to travel 50-75%

**About Red Hat

**Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

**Inclusion at Red Hat

**Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

**Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

Ready to deliver high-impact projects that shape Pandora’s retail experience?

_As a Senior Specialist, Project Management, you’ll play a key role in driving strategic initiatives within Pandora’s Store Creative & Design team. Based at our Copenhagen HQ, this role offers a unique opportunity to combine analytical thinking with creative vision, ensuring projects are delivered with excellence and enable markets to execute flawlessly.

**Strategy meets execution and collaboration

**In this role, you will support the successful delivery of high-impact projects and strategic workstreams that require close cross-functional collaboration. You’ll work alongside the Senior Manager to define and execute SC&D’s strategic priorities, ensuring best-in-class project management practices across the organization. From developing tools and trackers to preparing business cases and high-quality presentations, you’ll help maintain clarity and alignment at every stage.

You’ll also build strong partnerships across Marketing, Retail Excellence, Supply Chain, and global market teams, acting as a trusted advisor and key point of escalation. This is an exciting opportunity to influence Pandora’s global retail strategy and contribute to creating memorable brand environments for our customers.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Driving and supporting projects and strategic workstreams from kick-off to implementation and testing

• Defining project scope and plans in collaboration with functional experts and stakeholders

• Preparing business cases to evaluate benefits, costs, and risks of alternative options

• Facilitating cross-functional collaboration and problem-solving to meet deadlines

• Delivering regular updates to senior stakeholders, including key findings and recommendations

• Maintaining a full overview of SC&D projects and status trackers for clear communication

• Creating high-quality presentations for SC&D leadership and other stakeholders

• Establishing and role-modelling best-in-class project management practices

• Building strong relationships across global and market teams to ensure alignment

**To Succeed In This Role, You’ll Bring

**

• A Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Strategy, Finance, Economics, or related field

• 3–5 years of experience in strategic project management within Marketing, Retail, Consulting, or Business Development

• Proven ability to manage complex projects with strategic importance

• Strong analytical skills and experience creating business cases

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics

• Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and facilitating meetings independently

• Background in jewellery, retail, fashion, or FMCG is a plus

• Experience working in a global organization

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills

• Fluent in Business English

**Your new team

**You’ll join Pandora’s Store Creative & Design team, a creative and strategic group within Global Marketing dedicated to designing desirable brand environments and delivering exceptional customer experiences. From our Copenhagen HQ, we collaborate across functions and markets to bring Pandora’s vision to life.

**Additional Information

**Global career band: 5A

Did we get your attention?    If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply by attaching your CV and portfolio. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake    You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

**Our Purpose

**Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As a Senior Onboarding Consultant, you will drive the success of Planday by leading new customers through a comprehensive onboarding and implementation journey tailored to their business size, operational complexity, and technical requirements.

You will own more complex and strategic onboarding engagements, bringing a high degree of autonomy, strong implementation discipline, and a consultative mindset to every customer interaction. You will combine deep product expertise with strong technical aptitude to help customers design scalable ways of working, manage change effectively, and realise value quickly.

You will play a key role in helping customers successfully implement Planday within their business, especially where workflows, stakeholder groups, system configuration, and integration requirements are more advanced. Your ability to lead technically credible conversations, guide customers through implementation decisions, and proactively manage risks will be critical to achieving strong adoption, smooth go-lives, and long-term customer success.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Project manage end-to-end onboarding and multi-site implementation for upper mid-market and enterprise customer portfolios, with full ownership of strategic, technically complex, and high-value customer engagements.

• Act as the primary implementation lead for customers with more advanced operational or technical requirements, including complex workflows, multi-site setups, and tailored rollout plans

• Run high-quality discovery to understand customer goals, business processes, operational challenges, and implementation risks, and translate these into a clear onboarding plan

• Guide customers through solution design and configuration decisions, ensuring Planday is implemented in a way that aligns with their business needs and supports long-term success

• Lead implementation conversations with a broad range of stakeholders, including operational, commercial, technical, and executive contacts

• Deliver a high-quality onboarding experience through a consultative, structured, and customer-centric approach

• Proactively identify delivery risks, technical blockers, and adoption challenges, and drive them through to resolution

• Support customers through change management and go-live planning to ensure successful launches and strong early adoption

• Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and other internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and smooth handover across the customer lifecycle

• Maintain strong implementation governance, accurate CRM records, and disciplined use of internal processes, systems, and onboarding best practices

• Use data, customer insight, and frontline experience to identify opportunities to improve onboarding playbooks, implementation processes, and customer outcomes

• Act as a senior member of the team by sharing knowledge, raising the bar on execution, and contributing to continuous improvement across onboarding.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• Proven experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role, with experience owning more complex customer engagements

• Strong SaaS implementation experience, with the ability to lead customers through structured rollout and change processes from kickoff to go-live

• Strong technical aptitude and confidence discussing system configuration, implementation requirements, workflow design, and integration-related considerations with customers

• Experience managing multiple stakeholders across operational, technical, and leadership audiences

• Ability to run excellent discovery, uncover customer needs, and translate them into practical implementation plans and business outcomes

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build credibility with a wide range of stakeholders

• Excellent project, time management, and prioritisation skills across multiple concurrent customer journeys

• A proactive, self-directed approach with strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating with autonomy and accountability

• Empathy, patience, and a solutions-focused mindset, paired with the confidence to challenge constructively when needed

• Confidence using CRM systems and customer engagement tools, with strong process discipline and attention to detail

• High professionalism, integrity, and a collaborative, low-ego approach

• Experience in workforce-intensive industries such as hospitality, retail, healthcare, or shift-based environments is preferred

• Experience working on technically involved implementations, including integrations, data considerations, or more complex business process design, is highly desirable

**Success looks like

**

• Customers successfully go live on time with strong adoption and clear alignment to their business goals

• Complex onboarding and implementation projects are managed effectively, with risks identified early and handled proactively

• Customers feel confident in their solution design, implementation approach, and path to value

• Strong stakeholder relationships are built across customer teams, including more senior and technical contacts

• High customer satisfaction, strong implementation quality, and minimal escalations

• Consistent achievement of onboarding goals and KPIs, with strong ownership of outcomes

• Positive contribution to team culture, capability uplift, and continuous improvement across the onboarding function

_This position description is intended merely as a guideline of the responsibilities involved in the position. The employee is expected to perform any other duties as reasonably required by their Manager.

_**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

_Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

__At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

__As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all our candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process.

__All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to any personal characteristics.

Kickstart your career and level up your content & marketing skills in a fast‑growing SaaS scale‑up

We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Copywriter Intern to support our marketing team in creating engaging, clear, and conversion-driven content across channels.

You will play an important role in strengthening the quality and consistency of our messaging and gain hands-on experience writing for a B2B SaaS company. You will be learning how to translate complex product features into clear client value across the entire buying journey.

Working closely with the marketing team, you will help produce market-focused and client-centric content across owned and paid channels. You will be involved in everything from website copy and blog posts to LinkedIn posts, email campaigns, event materials, and sales enablement content.

This internship is ideal for someone who wants real responsibility, steep learning, and exposure to strategic SaaS marketing.

This is an exciting time to join Relesys. Through our strategic partnership with the Private Equity fund Copilot Capital, the coming years will bring significant growth and plenty of opportunities along the way. You'll have a unique chance to make a real impact, taking both your career and Relesys to the next level. As we like to say, joining a scale-up at this stage is a "once in a lifetime" opportunity! 🤩

**Responsibilities

**Your role as a copywriter will include, but will not be limited to...

• Write and edit content across channels, including website pages, blog posts, case stories, social media, email campaigns, paid ads, event materials, and sales assets.

• Support content creation throughout the full customer journey, from awareness and engagement to conversion and retention.

• Repurpose long-form content into shorter, channel-optimized formats to maximize reach and impact.

• Assist with website copywriting and optimization following SEO best practices, including landing page improvements.

• Monitor and analyze basic content performance metrics (with support) to identify what drives engagement and conversions.

• Ensure clear and consistent brand messaging and tone of voice across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success platforms.

• Conduct light competitor research and contribute insights to strengthen positioning and messaging.

• Take ownership of assigned copy tasks and smaller projects, while supporting ad-hoc marketing needs and turning client insights into compelling, value-driven communication.

**Who are you?

**

• Currently studying or recently graduated in Communication, Journalism, Marketing, Business, or a related field, with strong professional English writing skills (Scandinavian languages are a plus).

• Interested in B2B marketing and SaaS, with a basic understanding of social media platforms—especially LinkedIn - and a desire to learn SEO and digital marketing best practices.

• Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve your skills.

• Structured and detail-oriented, comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on your work.

• Proactive and able to translate complex topics into clear, engaging language, with a strong desire to take ownership and build a portfolio with real business impact.

• You can work full-time during your internship

• You are not afraid to bring your ideas to the table and challenge the ordinary

• Impeccable English skills, both verbal and written 🇬🇧

• You are located in or near Copenhagen as this internship is on-site 🇩🇰

What we offer

• "Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

• Positive, collaborative, and supportive colleagues who wish you to succeed

• Opportunities for professional growth and development as we are growing towards becoming a unicorn business

• Lots of challenges and opportunities, with respect and flexibility for your education

• Targeted feedback and guidance from your mentor to further improve your skills

• Delicious lunch scheme with cake every Thursday 🥗

• Homemade buns every Wednesday made by our lovely Piccoline

• Free barista coffee, tea, and a fridge filled with soda

• Our stylish Nordhavn office, just 100 meters from Orientkaj Metro, offers easy access to public transport and stunning ocean views

• Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!

**When do you start?

**

• Our Talent programme is custom-tailored for your internship period. However, we are looking for the next round of lovely interns to start in February 2027. We are inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't miss out and apply today!

• Portfolio or other? We value creativity and thinking outside of the box. Please show us examples of your work and demonstrate your copywriter skills in the best possible way!

• We cannot wait to review your application and meet our future colleague!

• Apply for the position by sending your CV through the Apply button

**We can't wait to hear from you!

****Who are we?

**Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app📱

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.

**Our Culture

**Building a world-class organization and culture is our highest priority. We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. We are eager to see what exciting contributions you, as our new colleague, will bring, as we believe that each and every individual has a tremendous influence on the whole 🌍

jobs.occupation: Senior Quantitative Developer - European Gas Fundamentals
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll help design and develop our new European gas supply–demand modelling capability, supporting short- and medium-term trading and portfolio decisions. You’ll combine strong Python development skills with quantitative modelling and market analysis, working closely with experienced energy market specialists and traders. This is an opportunity to shape the technical foundations of an important new modelling capability and see your work directly influence commercial decisions.

Welcome to Forecasting & Market Analysis You’ll join a collaborative team of quantitative developers and market analysts developing fundamental models, forecasts, and analytical tools across European gas and power markets.

You’ll play a central role in building our European gas modelling capabilities, working alongside colleagues with complementary expertise in energy fundamentals, quantitative modelling, and software development.

As a team, we collaborate across disciplines, share knowledge, and continuously improve how we model and understand energy markets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• co-developing and enhancing our new European gas supply–demand model, supporting gas trading, market analysis, and portfolio management.

• designing scalable, reliable Python-based models and contributing to their architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.

• modelling fundamental gas market drivers, including pipeline supplies, LNG imports, storage dynamics, consumption, infrastructure constraints, and cross-border flows.

• developing quantitative methodologies to analyse market balances, assess scenarios, and understand short- and medium-term market developments.

• integrating and processing diverse market datasets, ensuring data quality, transparency, and reliable model outputs.

• improving model performance, automation, testing, documentation, and deployment through modern software engineering practices.

• collaborating closely with gas analysts, traders, and other developers to turn complex market questions into practical modelling solutions.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have strong experience in Python development, quantitative modelling, software engineering, or a related field.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. • A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• Competitive salary + company paid pension

• DSB Business Card

• Private health insurance

• Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• Lunch subsidized by the company

• Company phone and company credit card

• Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter in English via our website: https://sparrowquantum.com/position?id=8695575

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

As a key member of the Crushing leadership team, the position will establish the processes, capabilities, and governance required to create a repeatable, scalable execution model that drives customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and sustainable profitable growth

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own the Crushing execution value stream from proposal through customer acceptance.

• Deliver profitable, on-time project execution across the global Crushing portfolio.

• Lead proposal development, bid governance, commercial risk management and execution planning.

• Establish world-class execution processes, governance and performance management.

• Drive customer satisfaction through excellence in project delivery and contract fulfilment.

• Ensure supplier readiness, qualification and performance to support sustainable growth.

• Lead and develop a high-performing global execution organisation.

• Partner across Product Line Management, Engineering, Sales and Aftermarket to deliver integrated customer solutions.

• Drive continuous improvement, standardisation and scalable execution excellence.

**What You Bring

**

• Proven leadership of complex proposals, projects or capital equipment deliveries.

• Strong commercial mindset with a focus on profitable execution and customer outcomes.

• Ability to lead cross-functional global teams and drive accountability.

• Experience managing contractual risk, project performance and customer relationships.

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a solid understanding of IT integrations and a talent for creating structure, progress and strong working relationships?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a hands-on Technical Project Manager to support a major global transformation programme involving the implementation of new systems, global processes and data migration.

The programme implements a new Transportation Management System (TMFF), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and a Vendor Invoice Management solution (Basware and AP Essentials.

As Technical Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving and coordinating integration projects across teams, integration specialists and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to create structure, draft plans, ensure progress and make sure that tasks, responsibilities, dependencies and deadlines are clearly defined and followed up.

You will act as the link between diverse teams and the business, helping translate technical challenges into clear business requirements – and vice versa.

This is not a developer role. However, you should have a good technical understanding of integrations, data flows and system dependencies, enabling you to engage confidently in technical discussions and challenge proposed solutions when needed.

You should also enjoy getting involved in the practical aspects of project management, including communication, documentation, process descriptions and mapping integration flows. It is a must that you know when to support and when to drive tasks, content, colleagues to ensure progress.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and coordinate integration projects across implementation and integration teams and vendor teams, i.e., integration to e-invoicing governmental portals

• Act as the link between technical teams, system owners, implementation teams and business stakeholders.

• Create structure, clear priorities, realistic timelines and well-defined project plans.

• Ensure proper task management and follow-up in Jira.

• Make sure tasks are clearly described, assigned to the right people and followed through to completion. You support the integration team with describing their tasks, flow descriptions, etc.

• Coordinate resources, dependencies and delivery schedules across teams.

• Support the documentation of integration flows, system dependencies and processes.

• Translate technical issues into business requirements and ensure alignment between business and IT.

• Follow up on progress, identify bottlenecks and help resolve issues before they impact delivery.

• Coordinate testing, deployment and operational handover where relevant.

Your background

We are looking for someone with solid experience in technical project management and, in particular, system integration projects.

You do not need to be a technical specialist or developer, but you must understand how systems communicate and how integrations work.

Ideally, you have:

• Experience managing IT integration projects.

• A good understanding of APIs, CSV, data flows and integration patterns.

• An understanding of system dependencies and how different applications interact.

• Experience coordinating technical teams, developers or integration specialists.

• Experience with project planning, resource coordination, and delivery follow-up.

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.

• The ability to create clear documentation, process descriptions and integration flow diagrams.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ERP or TMS solutions is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from logistics and transportation is also an advantage, but we are equally interested in candidates from finance, operations or other industries who have moved into IT and integration projects.

Who are you?

Your personality will be just as important as your technical and project management experience.

You are someone who can create momentum and gain the respect of others without relying on formal management authority.

You are structured, detail-oriented and persistent when it comes to following up and ensuring that things get done.

At the same time, you are approachable and understand the importance of building good relationships.

You are comfortable working with different personalities, handling disagreements and challenging existing ways of working in a constructive manner.

You know when to push and when to listen. You can stand your ground without being overly dominant, and you understand that successful project delivery depends on bringing people along.

You are pragmatic, have a good sense of humour and can navigate different situations with confidence and good judgement.

The team

You will report to the Programme Lead and work closely with integration specialists, system owners, workstream leads, implementation project managers and solution architects to mention just a few.

What we offer

• An important role in a major global transformation programme.

• An international working environment with colleagues across different countries.

• A role combining technical insight, project management and relationship building.

• The opportunity to make a visible difference to project delivery and collaboration.

Location: Hvidovre is preferred, but Viby is also an option for the right candidate.

**Travel:**Approximately once a month between locations.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

Are you interested in gaining hands-on experience within Global Procurement at one of the world's leading jewellery brands? Do you enjoy working with data, analysis, and stakeholder collaboration in a dynamic international environment?

Pandora is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Global Procurement team. In this role, you will support sourcing activities, procurement projects, and business analysis across different spend categories while working closely with category managers and stakeholders across the organisation.

This is a unique opportunity to gain valuable insight into procurement within a global organisation operating across the full value chain. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will contribute to sourcing activities, supplier management, data analysis, and process improvements while building both professional skills and practical business experience.

Key Responsibilities

You will be exposed to a variety of tasks within Procurement and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation. We expect you to take ownership of your responsibilities and contribute proactively to ongoing projects and initiatives.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Support Procurement colleagues with various procurement activities

• Contribute to sourcing projects and tenders across spend categories

• Project manage smaller projects and tasks independently

• Conduct data analyses and create business insights

• Create and deliver presentations for internal stakeholders

• Assist with the implementation of new processes across the global organisation

• Engage in dialogue with suppliers on various topics, including compliance-related activities

• Support data quality initiatives and ad hoc administrative tasks related to contract management

Your Team

Working in Global Procurement, you will join a team that partners with stakeholders across Pandora to drive value through strategic sourcing, supplier collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives across a broad range of indirect spend categories.

The Global Procurement team is part of the Group Commercial organisation. You will work alongside more than 20 skilled colleagues in an international and collaborative environment and report to the Director of one of our Indirect Procurement categories.

You will be part of an exciting business area and work in an international hub of passionate, performance-driven, and can-do spirited colleagues.

Qualifications

You might be the person we are looking for if you are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree and ideally have at least two years remaining before graduation.

We hope you can demonstrate:

• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree or similar in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Economics, or Data Management

• Excellent communication skills in English

• Strong Excel skills and an analytical mindset

• A genuine interest in Procurement and related disciplines

• Great interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across different functions

• A flair for creating professional and impactful presentations in PowerPoint

Personal Competencies

We are looking for someone who is:

• Proactive, curious, and eager to learn

• A humble and enthusiastic team player

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership

• Structured and detail-oriented in their approach

• Not afraid to take initiative and responsibility

• Ambitious and motivated to develop professionally

You Will Get

A position as Student Assistant in Global Procurement offers an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organisation.

You will get:

• Valuable work experience from a globally recognised brand within Procurement across different spend categories

• Exposure to a fast-moving and dynamic environment where our people and values are at the centre of what we do

• A chance to challenge yourself and apply what you have learned in a global business environment

• Support and coaching from your manager as well as a diverse and experienced team

• Flexible working hours, especially around exam periods

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible and required).

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery using 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030.

Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

New Power Partners is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex construction and building projects across Europe.

The role is responsible for managing projects from planning and procurement through construction and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with clients, consultants, contractors, and authorities, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.

In addition to project delivery, the role includes supporting business growth through client development, tender support, and identifying new opportunities. As the business expands, the successful candidate will play a key role in mentoring colleagues and, over time, helping establish and develop a team of project managers and specialists.

About Site Solutions

Site Solutions develops and delivers turnkey solutions for the onshore and offshore wind industry – covering everything from facilities and workforce logistics to operational planning and site coordination. We work closely with global project teams to ensure efficient site setups that keep projects running smoothly and safely.

Site Solutions is a great team of nine employees, and the Senior Project Manager will work closely with all team members while contributing both strategically and operationally to the development and delivery of our services.

While our heritage is rooted in the wind industry, we increasingly support customers across construction, infrastructure and industrial sectors where temporary site facilities are critical for successful project execution.

What the role offers

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

• Lead construction and building projects from initiation to completion.

• Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, and project risks.

• Coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and authorities.

• Ensure projects comply with applicable regulations, HSE requirements, and quality standards.

• Provide clear project governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

Commercial & Client Management

• Build and maintain strong client relationships.

• Support tendering, procurement, and contract management activities.

• Manage project commercial performance, including budgets, forecasts, variations, and claims.

• Identify opportunities for additional services and long-term client collaboration.

Business Development

• Support business growth through networking, client engagement, and market development.

• Contribute to proposals, commercial discussions, and new project opportunities.

• Help strengthen New Power Partners' position within the Danish construction sector.

Team Development

• Mentor and support junior project managers and consultants.

• Share knowledge and best practices across projects.

• Support recruitment and onboarding as the team grows.

• Contribute to building a collaborative and high-performing project organization.

Qualifications & Experience

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Building Technology, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of project management experience within the Danish building and construction industry.

• Proven track record delivering commercial, industrial, residential, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.

• Strong understanding of Danish construction processes and regulations.

• Experience with contract management, procurement, and stakeholder management.

• Familiarity with AB18, ABT18, and ABR18 is an advantage.

• Fluent in Danish and English.

Key Competencies

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

• Commercially minded with sound contractual understanding.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented.

• Ability to balance hands-on project execution with business development.

• Leadership potential with an interest in developing people and teams.

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by:

• Safe and successful project delivery.

• High client satisfaction and repeat business.

• Strong financial and commercial project performance.

• Development of new business opportunities.

• Contribution to the growth of the project management team and the wider business.

Why join New Power Partners?

You will work in an international project environment, collaborate with experienced colleagues and customers, and play a role in shaping the future of Site Solutions.

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Project Manager who enjoys delivering complex projects, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the growth of both the business and future project teams**.

jobs.occupation: Interest Rate Option Trader – Graduate / Early Career
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

More specifically, you will:

• Support pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions under experienced traders

• Monitor interest rate markets, volatility, and economic developments with the team

• Analyse portfolio exposures and help manage risk within agreed limits

• Build and improve tools for pricing and risk monitoring using Python or similar languages

• Collaborate with sales, quant, risk, and operations colleagues to support accurate trade processing

**About You

**You are a recent graduate or have up to two years of relevant experience in trading, quantitative analysis, asset management or a related field. Previous trading experience is not required. We are interested in your analytical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn.

• Degree in economics with a technical focus, alternatively in mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related quantitative field

• Strong numerical and analytical skills with a structured approach to problem solving

• Genuine interest in fixed income markets and a desire to build a career in trading

• Programming ability in Python or a comparable language, applied to practical problems

• Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language

• Sound judgement, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and raise concerns

Familiarity with derivatives, probability, statistics, or numerical methods is an advantage, though no prior trading experience is required. Academic projects, relevant coursework, or internships are all useful ways to demonstrate your analytical interest.

**What We Offer You

**This role offers structured learning through direct collaboration with experienced traders, with responsibility growing as your knowledge deepens. This is a full-time, in-office role with daily access to colleagues who are invested in your progress and development.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, apply by submitting your CV, cover letter and grade transcripts. If you have any questions before applying you can reach out to hiring manager Frederik Dimo-Ungermann at fdi@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!
